Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

Verb be

IamI’m Ali.
YouareYou’re my friend.
He / SheisShe’s Madina.
ItisIt’s my school.
We / TheyareWe’re students.
notam not / isn’t / aren’tI’m not late. He isn’t sad.

⭐ Short forms: I am → I’m, you are → you’re, he is → he’s (qisqa shakllar)

❓ Where are you from? Are you from Uzbekistan?

❓ How do you say hello and goodbye to your friends in Uzbekistan?

My Mini Talk

🎤

Rejaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda 30 soniya gapiring.

🎯 All about me

  1. 1Say hello and your name
  2. 2Say your age
  3. 3Say where you are from
  4. 4Say goodbye

Example: Hello! I’m Bobur. My name is spelled B-O-B-U-R. I’m eleven years old. I’m from Samarkand in Uzbekistan. I’m a student. My teacher is very nice. My best friend is Ali. He is in my class. We are happy in English class. Goodbye! See you later!

🏆 Now I can … Colour the stars!

  • ☆☆☆I can say hello and goodbye.
  • ☆☆☆I can talk about myself with be.
  • ☆☆☆I can ask my friends questions.

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

My, your, his, her + ’s

ImyThis is my mom.
youyourIs she your sister?
hehisHis name is Bobur.
sheherHer name is Laylo.
AliAli’sThis is Ali’s dad.
Who / WhatWho is …? What is …?Who is she? She’s my aunt.

⭐ ’s = belongs to: Madina’s mom = Madinaning onasi

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

Where + be from / be in

Whereare you from?I’m from Bukhara.
Whereis he from?He’s from Korea.
Whereis your school?It’s in Chilonzor.
Whereare they?They’re in Tashkent.
Are youfrom …?Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.

⭐ be from = country or city you come from; be in = place you are now (hozir qayerdasan)

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

What time? When? What day?

What timeis it?It’s seven o’clock.
What timeis lunch?It’s at half past twelve.
Whenis Maths?It’s on Monday.
What dayis it today?It’s Friday.
at+ timeat 8 o’clock
on+ dayon Saturday

⭐ at + time (at 9:00), on + day (on Monday) — vaqt uchun at, kun uchun on

Grammar Helper

Adjectives and very

Iam + adjectiveI’m very tall.
Sheis + adjectiveShe’s cute.
adjective + noun—Ali has short black hair.
very+ adjectiveMadina is very pretty.
What color…?is / areWhat color are your eyes? They’re brown.
… or …?choose oneIs he tall or short? He’s short.

  4. 4Say where you buy clothes

Example: Hi! I’m Madina. Today I’m wearing a white shirt and a blue skirt. My favourite clothes are these black jeans. I love pink and purple. I never wear brown. I buy clothes at the bazaar with my mum. Some jackets there are too expensive. Which one do you like?

can / can’t

should / shouldn’t
